input_unit: one standardized compound with compound_id, canonical_smiles, source and upstream rank

swissadme.interpretation: Drug-likeness or Lipinski Yes is a prioritization signal, not proof that a compound is orally deliverable, effective or safe. A No result must not automatically remove a compound from the COPD inhalation-review branch.

branches.oral_priority: compound meets selected oral-oriented heuristics; retain for ranking and expert review
branches.inhalation_expert_review: compound fails one or more oral-oriented heuristics; retain complete outputs for Zhang Dandan or another designated expert

inhalation_warning: Inhalation suitability cannot be inferred from SwissADME drug-likeness alone. Formulation, aerosol/particle behavior, lung deposition, local availability, clearance, device and route-specific safety require separate expert assessment.
